subject: Vendor onboarding: tax & billing documents needed for Altavista AI
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Morales <jenna@altavista.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: tax & billing documents needed for Altavista AI

Hi Jenna —

Welcome — excited to get Altavista live in our procurement system. To get you set up and issue a PO, our finance team needs a few standard items. Can you please provide the items below by end of week? If anything is already available, sending the PDFs is perfect.

Required (please upload or attach):
- Official legal entity name exactly as registered
- W-9 (if US) or W-8BEN-E (if non-US entity) — signed and dated
- VAT registration certificate (if EU) or VAT number confirmation
- Billing contact and billing@ email address
- Remit-to address for wire/ACH

Optional but helpful:
- Draft invoice (sample) so we can confirm cost center / GL mapping
- Signed vendor engagement form (we can send via DocuSign)

Notes / next steps:
- Once those documents are in, finance will create the vendor record and raise a PO (typical turnaround 2–3 business days).
- Default payment terms we expect are Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated.

Attachments: none on this message.

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa (Finance) and Karthik (Procurement) to flag any additional checklist items.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Sales Ops / Vendor Intake
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks, Jenna — received, appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications so finance can proceed: 

1) W-8BEN-E — correct form for a Cyprus company, that looks fine.
2) VAT certificate — good to have the certificate. For our AP process we just need the number and the certificate on file; we will not apply reverse charge on our side by default. If Altavista prefers reverse-charge wording on the invoice, please include the EU reverse charge line and call it out on the invoice.
3) Legal name & remit address — matched to the certificate, so this is good.

Action items for you:
- If you want reverse-charge wording, please upload a final invoice with that line; otherwise we will process as provided.
- Please sign the vendor engagement form we just sent via DocuSign (link below). Signing accelerates PO creation.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/altavista/vendor-engagement-12345

We'll aim to create the vendor record and issue a PO once Marissa confirms receipt in AP. Thanks — cc'ing Marissa to confirm the intake and timing.

Best,
Evelyn
